EC1: - Patients suffering from ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI)
EC2: - Patients need for immediate cardiac catheterization
EC3: - Elevated liver enzymes (Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) [OR] and Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) three times the upper limit of normal).
EC5: - Any contraindication to carvedilol, [OR] or atorvastatin.
EC6: - Patients on regular use of vitamins, [OR] minerals.
EC7: - Using medication with antioxidant properties e.g., beta-carotene, [OR] vitamin E, [OR] vitamin C, [OR] selenium, [OR] theophylline [OR] or N-acetyl cysteine 7 days prior to CC.
EC8: - Hemodynamically unstable patients (defined as abnormal [OR] or unstable blood pressure, especially hypotension (blood pressure less than 90/60 mm Hg).
EC11: - Using of carvedilol in the past three months.
EC12: - Using a nephrotoxic agent in the past 48 hours [OR] or exposure to a contrast agent in the past 7 days prior to cardiac catheterization.
